name: sun-sea-o
title: Module-Based Agreement Builder
description: Agreements assembled from individual text modules, each independently authored, negotiated, and signed. The full agreement emerges over time.
audience: Two parties entering into agreements — freelancers and clients, business partners, or any situation where a contract is negotiated incrementally rather than signed all at once.
useCases: Create projects and invite a counterparty via email with passphrase verification
Build agreements from individual text modules (6 starter templates available)
Negotiate module content via proposals (accept, reject, counter)
Sign modules independently — auto-lock when both parties agree
Split modules into separate agreements as negotiations evolve
Track version history and signature log with timestamps
Generate PDF previews with SHA-256 verification codes
Receive in-app notifications for all agreement activity

dataPrivacy.storage: All data stored in Supabase cloud database with row-level security.
dataPrivacy.authentication: Google OAuth via Supabase Auth. Each user only sees their own projects and agreements.
dataPrivacy.signatures: Signing actions recorded with IP, user agent, and timestamp for audit trail.
dataPrivacy.realtime: Live updates via Supabase realtime subscriptions between both parties.
